title: Settings as one page; billing through Stripe; no cancel survey
recommendation: One Settings page with four cards (Brand, Notifications, Plan, Your account); the Plan card opens the Stripe portal when the account has a Stripe customer and shows a support line otherwise; the Password page becomes a reset-email button; the cancel survey goes; support@ is the one address.

questions.q: Policy: does the Stripe portal replace the in-app card list, with the support line for accounts that have no Stripe customer?
questions.recommended: Yes. The portal link code exists; the card list has no add button and never shows the default card.

questions.q: Policy: does the cancel survey (required reason, re-subscribe question) go?
questions.recommended: Yes. Nothing stores the answers on the subscription. If William wants the signal, one optional free-text line after the cancel is enough.

questions.q: Profile folds into Settings as "Your account", and the account menu item reads "Settings"?
questions.recommended: Yes. Once Contacts and Learn leave the nav (D7), the account menu is the only way into Settings, so it needs the item.
